title: NEUROSCAN: Clinical Brain MRI Tumor Diagnostic Engine with Explainable AI (Grad-CAM) and From-Scratch Convolutional Architecture
description: NEUROSCAN is an enterprise-grade clinical neuro-radiology platform and academic benchmarking suite for autonomous brain tumor neoplasm classification and lesion localization in T1 contrast-enhanced axial MRI scans.
